units.unit: The student has to write an essay on whether Hong Kong should tighten rent control on subdivided units.
The student knows nothing about the topic yet.
The student hasn't settled on a claim yet.
The student wants sources that define what a subdivided unit is and how common they are.
The student wants evidence on what rent control has actually done to rents and housing supply where it's been tried.
The student wants at least one counter-view arguing against tightening controls.
The student wants to form their own position rather than repeat one side.
D1 defines subdivided units and frames the debate so the student can understand the basics.
D7 gives a real-world cautionary case on rent freezes to weigh evidence.
The student needs evidence on what rent control actually does and a counter-view.
D11 directly reports what tenants themselves say they need.
This helps the student test whether rent level is really the main problem.
The student wants the basic definition and scale of subdivided units first.
